name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow close to your torso.
Squeeze at the top, then lower the weight under control until the arm is straight.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A standing biceps curl where you alternate arms, giving each side time to rest and letting you focus on form.

safetyNotes: Choose a weight you can lift without swinging. Stop if you feel sharp elbow or wrist pain.
